verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸ ਨ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਲਟੈ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਉ ਸੁ ਟੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: nis na ghaTai na laTai saseear dheep jot kusam baas hoo(n) na miTai aau su Tev sev kee ||

en.bdb: May this night of enjoying blissful union with my Lord not end, nor should the soothing light of the lamp-like moon recede. May the flowers remain laden with fragrance nor should the power of voiceless voice-meditation decrease from my heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਘਟੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ  ਰਸਨਾ ਪਰਸ ਰਸ ਰਸਕਿ ਸਮੇਵ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj kathaa na ghaTai sravan surat mat  rasanaa paras ras rasak samev kee ||

en.bdb: May this spiritual stability not recede nor should the sweetness of sound decrease in my ears. With the absorption of the divine elixir, may the desire of my tongue to remain engrossed in that elixir not wane.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਆਰਸ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਰੀਆ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhraa na parai ar karai na aaras praves ridhai bareeaa sa(n)jog alakh abhev kee ||

en.bdb: May the sleep not burden me nor should laziness effect my heart, because an opportunity of enjoying the inaccessible Lord has been formed (opportunity of enjoying the bliss of union with Lord exists).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਚਉਗੁਨੋ ਬਢੈ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ  ਦਇਆ ਦਸ ਗੁਨੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕੀ ॥੬੫੩॥
verses.translit_en: chaau chit chauguno baddai prabal prem nem  dhiaa dhas gunee upajai dhiaal dhev kee ||653||

en.bdb: Bless me that this desire and enthusiasm of my heart becomes fourfold. May the love within me become more powerful and unbearable and the benevolence of the beloved effulgent Lord appear ten times more for me.  (653)
